name: Home Depot RDC - Pittston Township PA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Cross-dock RDC; truck entrance off the public road at the SW corner. A z20 view of the inner perimeter point shows a small guard-booth structure beside the drive where it crosses the property line into the yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small 1-2-vehicle-footprint booth visible at the inner gate point where the access drive enters the truck yard, set back from the public road behind the employee parking.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron between the inner gate and the dock faces gives ample post-gate queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep approach from the SW gate along the long dock apron; comfortably 3+ trucks of stacking.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and generous paved width at the SW entrance; room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dense regular dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in along the long NW face and the long SE face — well over 100 doors total (cross-dock RDC).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout: receiving on one long face, shipping on the opposite long face — two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop yard with multiple rows of parked trailers on the NE end of the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (CenterPoint Commerce & Trade Park) outside Pittston Township, surrounded by warehouses and woodland — judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated from imagery; lane count at the gate not fully resolved.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count from z17-z19 imagery across dock faces and drop yard.
